records.en: ◆ The Transcenders can explore different ruin sites, guided by their radar in search of mysterious gemstones.
◆ While exploring, Transcenders can excavate within the ruins using the Steeltooth, which spends its Stamina to dig in the ground.
◆ Besides gemstones, many interesting events or rewards can also be encountered during exploration.
◆ Stones that are excavated are stored inside the Steeltooth. When players return to camp, these stones are converted into experience for the Steeltooth to make it stronger.
◆ As Steeltooth levels up, it becomes capable of excavating harder stones and finding rarer gemstones in the ruins.
◆ Making progress while exploring the ruins sites can unlock more locations. Visit more sites and discover more gemstones!
◆ Transcender can appraise the gemstones they find in the Appraisal menu.
◆ Depending on the origin of the gemstones, different mysterious exhibits can be revealed. The higher the level of the gemstone, the higher the probability of obtaining rare exhibits.
◆ Exhibits can be donated or displayed in the museum. Once on display, they will provide special enhancements to the Transcenders and make them stronger!
◆ Duplicate exhibits will be converted into materials that can be used to upgrade the specific exhibit and improve its bonus effects.

◆ The stamina of Steeltooth will recover automatically every day, but be aware that the total amount of stamina has a limit. Once the limit has been reached, Steeltooth will no longer recover stamina on its own.
